notes: This contract pins the bounded IEEE 1516.2-2025 Table 1/6.2.1 modification-date presentation rule. The official DIF schema remains responsible for XML Schema date/calendar validity; Umbra's composition preflight rejects the schema-valid timezone-suffixed forms admitted by xs:date and requires the exact YYYY-MM-DD lexical form when a DIF module supplies a modificationDate. Omitted values remain representable for incomplete DIF modules. This is private source/test traceability only, not FOM conformance or public-service evidence.
